codeReview.summary: Implementation satisfies the feature intent: prepare_agent_in_pane and daemon check_agent_health now use send_text_enter with engine-specific enter_delay_ms(), and the old send_keys calls are removed from those paths. Tests were added to exercise delay behavior across engines.

issues.description: New tests call std::env::set_current_dir in-process (also at lines 131 and 155) without restoring it, which can introduce race/flakiness when tests run in parallel because cwd is global process state.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The rust-worker skill mandates RED-first TDD (write failing tests first and run them), but this worker implemented code changes before creating the new tests and did not show a failing-test run for those tests.
